title: 自訂動作結果可選字複製
summary: 自訂動作的文字與 Markdown 結果現在可選取部分文字，複製操作與 OCR 結果視窗一致。
highlights: 保留 Markdown 排版，支援滑鼠選字、Ctrl+A 全選與 Ctrl+C 複製。
底部按鈕依選取狀態切換為「複製所選文字」或「複製全部」。
usage: 執行輸出至視窗或 Markdown 的自訂動作，點入結果選取文字後複製；未選取時，底部按鈕會複製完整原始輸出。

en.title: Select and copy custom action results
en.summary: Text and Markdown results now support selecting and copying part of the output, matching the OCR result window.
highlights: Keep Markdown formatting while selecting text with the mouse, selecting all with Ctrl+A, and copying with Ctrl+C.
The bottom button switches between Copy selected text and Copy all to match the selection.
en.usage: Run a custom action with window or Markdown output, then click into the result to select and copy text. With no selection, the bottom button copies the complete original output.
